experiment: ERA on AgentDescent -- LLM-SRBench equation discovery
task: LLM-SRBench scientific equation discovery, mean min(12, -log10(NMSE)) on held-out samples
comparability: Same benchmark, splits and metrics as arXiv:2504.10415; different protocol. The paper's methods see one problem at a time with the data in context; here the model writes one program that never sees a sample and is run sandboxed over every problem. Numbers here are not directly comparable to the paper's tables.
